description: This file defines the PHP class 'LeaveStatusWithLengthDays' within the OrangeHRM leave request DTOs. It models a leave status with an associated length in days, providing getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: LeaveStatusWithLengthDays
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class representing a leave status with an associated length in days.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the object with id, name, and optional lengthDays.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave status.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave status.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave status.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave status.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length of leave in days.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length of leave in days.

methods.name: addToLengthDays
methods.description: Adds a specified number of days to the current length days.
